fact: The Botswana Press Agency reports that UniPod Botswana at the University of Botswana incubates business ideas, has ten specialised laboratories and has six start-ups at commercial acceleration (TRL 6-9).
The Botswana Innovation Hub is to provide Botswana Tech Fund portfolio companies with physical infrastructure, deal pipelines and ecosystem integration, per Disrupt Africa.
We Are Tech Africa reports the Botswana Innovation Fund and Scalar International launched a 12-month accelerator supporting ten climate and digital startups.
TechCabal reports the Botswana Innovation Fund and Scalar International launched on 10 March 2026 in Gaborone a 12-month programme supporting 10 climate and digital startups.
